cheng: Quick heads-up — seeing a regression on the MQA/GQA path when using paged KV-cache layout after yesterday's kernel-autotune deploy. P99 up ~18%, throughput down ~12% on H100.
alex: oof. repro steps? any profiler traces / kernel picks?
cheng: Repro command I used:
```
./bench --model gptx-large --seq 2048 --batch 8 \
  --kv-layout paged --mq-mode MQA --autotune=on --device h100
```
Profiler dump (trimmed):
```
model=gptx-large seq=2048 batch=8 device=H100(sm90)
tokens/s=42.1k (was 48.0k)
p99=312ms (was 265ms)
kernel selection summary:
 - qkv_pack: qkv_pack_generic
 - attention: attn_block_paged_sm_small  <-- selected
 - kv_pack: kv_paged_layout_b32
autotuner: block_candidate=[64,128,256], chosen=64, score=0.61
```
I think the autotuner is picking a smaller block size (64) for paged layout on SM90 which reduces occupancy with MQA. On A100 we didn't see this (A100 picked 128).

maria: hmm MQA changes per-head math & memory strides — smaller block may blow up SM shared memory usage or force extra synchronization. Any shared mem / l2 spill counters in the trace?
cheng: yes: sm_shared_eff dropped ~22%, l2_writeback increased. The selected `attn_block_paged_sm_small` kernel assumes packed heads contiguous in memory; with MQA packing it causes extra remap work. Autotuner's device model for sm90 didn't account for MQA head packing factor.

sam: can we hotfix by forcing kernel policy fallback? e.g., prefer `attn_block_mqa_hybrid` when mq-mode=MQA and kv-layout=paged
alex: sounds reasonable. Alternatively toggle kv-layout to contiguous for now (can do in customer config). But we should avoid rollback of autotuner global state.

dev-bot: deploy 2026-03-16T21:12:42 by eng-runtime/autotune completed (id: d4f2a1). Linked logs: https://internal-ci/eng-runtime/d4f2a1
benchmark-bot: nightly perf job for gptx-large on h100: https://ci/bench/98765 diff tokens/s -11.7% p99 +17.8%

maria: Proposed guard: if mq-mode==MQA AND kv-layout==paged AND device.sm>=90 then require chosen_block>=128 else fall back to device-default kernel. That keeps autotune but blocks pathological small-block picks.
cheng: +1. I'll prototype a policy change. Also want to add a new metric to autotuner loss: `kv_remap_overhead` measured by extra mem copies — to penalize kernels that break head-contiguity.

sam: Do we have a regression ticket? I'll open one if you want.
cheng: Created perf issue #4231 (summary: "MQA+paged KV: autotuner picks small block on SM90 -> perf regression"). Linking trace and autotune logs. I'll push a micro-patch to kernel_policy to add the guard, run bench matrix, and @eng-ml for validation.
alex: thanks. Once patch lands, let's run perf matrix across seq=[1024,2048,4096], batch=[4,8,16] on H100 and A100 to ensure no regressions.
maria: also add unit test that simulates MQA packing (head stride mismatch) to autotuner simulator. Saves us from future surprises.
cheng: Agreed. Plan: patch -> internal canary -> full rollout. ETA for patch: EOD today. I'll post results here. :thumbsup:
